gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-plein: Bpmf Iansui writes like toothpaste squeezed in one steady line, relaxed and hand-drawn, with an s that opens wide. Plein follows with clean, dependable letters, pleasant when the text stays brief.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-epunda-slab: Distinctive and expressive, Bruno Ace draws a ruler-drawn, constant-width line, with counters that stay connected to the outside. Epunda Slab sits beside it, serif and dignified, with a gaping c.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-fauna-one: Ruler-sharp, Bruno Ace keeps curves and stems in lockstep. Fauna One settles in beneath with a literary, dignified voice, its shallow ascenders and descenders keeping each line neatly compact.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, with big counters and open curves. Bruno Ace's plain ballpoint-like line feels distinctive and expressive, with a moderate lowercase that sits lower than Glegoo's.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noticia-text: Bruno Ace has a blunt, round-tip marker feel from end to end, with counters open to the outside. Noticia Text adds literary dignity, its lowercase filling most of the letter height.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-piazzolla: Expressive from the first letter, Bruno Ace spaces its characters out one beat at a time on a ruler-drawn line. Piazzolla, refined serif, handles the quiet work, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-pridi: Bruno Ace is all display, crossbars matching the stems and counters open to the outside. Pridi handles the reading, refined and classic, its small letters standing proud, almost capital-sized.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-epunda-slab: Letters strung like beads on a long thread: that's Bruno Ace SC. Epunda Slab grounds it with dignified serif forms and a visibly gaping c, rounded where the heading stays constant.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-fauna-one: Open-mouthed and unhurried, Bruno Ace SC keeps an s whose spine matches its terminals. Fauna One brings literary dignity, its wide-entry e and shallow ascenders softening the display above.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-hanuman: Bruno Ace SC has no swelling where curves meet stems, just open apertures and a constant line. And Hanuman's high-waisted, traditional lowercase gives the heading, best at large display sizes, a refined counterpart.
